question: The part of the Peninsular plateau lying north of the Narmada river is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Highlands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Central Highlands**

 
 
• The Central Highlands are a vast plateau region in peninsular India.
 
• They are bounded by the Vindhya Range to the north, the Satpura Range to the north-west, and the Eastern Ghats to the east.
 
• The region is known for its diverse landscapes, including rolling hills, valleys, and river basins.
 
• It is home to several important rivers like the Narmada and Tapti.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Ghats**

 
 
• The Western Ghats are a mountain range along the western coast of India, running parallel to the Arabian Sea.
 
• They are known for their lush green forests, diverse wildlife, and numerous waterfalls.
 
• The Western Ghats are a biodiversity hotspot and play a crucial role in India's monsoon system. They are also a source of several important rivers like the Kaveri and Krishna. 
 
 
 
• **Eastern Ghats**
 
 
• The Eastern Ghats are a discontinuous range of hills and mountains along the eastern coast of India.
 
• They are not as high or continuous as the Western Ghats.
 
• The Eastern Ghats are known for their scenic beauty, temples, and archaeological sites.
 
• They are also home to several rivers like the Godavari and Mahanadi.
 
 
 
• **Deccan Plateau**
 
 
• The Deccan Plateau is a large plateau in southern India, covering most of the southern peninsula.
 
• It is bounded by the Western Ghats on the west and the Eastern Ghats on the east.
 
• The Deccan Plateau is known for its black soil, which is ideal for cotton cultivation.
 
• It is also home to several important cities like Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Pune.
